# Galanti Digital

> AI-first digital marketing for small businesses in Israel. Run by Gil Galanti, a senior digital marketing strategist with 25 years of experience growing digital products in the US market, now bringing the same playbook to local Israeli businesses.

## About

Gil Galanti is based in Kfar Netter, Israel. For most of his career he served as marketing manager at Conceptis, an Israeli company running one of the world's most popular puzzle game websites (conceptispuzzles.com) and a portfolio of 16 mobile games on the App Store and Google Play. He has also consulted for international brands, including leading the catalog rewrite and AEO initiative for Empire Vacations in Hoboken, NJ, and co-developing the world's first patented diamond price index (US20060265310A1) at IDEX Online.

Galanti Digital's core thesis: traditional search is giving way to AI engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. The businesses that win will be those optimized for AI discovery — not just Google rankings.

## Services

### AI-First Websites
Fast, schema-rich websites built for the AI age. Includes detailed Schema.org markup readable by LLMs, an llms.txt file, and a WebMCP endpoint that lets AI agents interact with the business directly — answering questions and capturing leads without the user leaving the AI interface.

### Google Business Profile (GBP) Management
Setup, ownership verification, optimization, review responses (positive and negative), update posts, and ongoing management of Google Business Profile. GBP is the most important local discovery asset after the website.

### Reputation Management
A customer feedback system that drives new reviews to the Google Business Profile, plus a managed response service for incoming reviews. Keeps the business focused on its core work while the local reputation grows.

### Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & Discovery
Optimization for AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Includes advanced Schema.org markup, dedicated llms.txt files, and information architecture that makes the business the top recommendation when prospects ask AI where to spend their money.

### Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Traditional SEO: Google Search Console setup and analysis, on-page optimization, and backlink profile consulting. Based on 25 years of hands-on practitioner experience.

### Professional Photography & 360° Tours
On-site photography package covering ambiance, interior, and exterior shots, plus 360° (Photo Sphere) virtual tours that let visitors explore the business directly from Google Maps. Shot by a Level 6 Google Local Guide and experienced 360° photographer whose Google Maps photos have earned over 14 million views.

### Strategic Consulting
One-on-one consulting (via Zoom or in person) that analyzes the business's current digital activity and its competitors, then distills a clear, prioritized action plan tailored to a local business budget — cutting through the noise of organic, paid, social, AI, and automation options.

### AI Integrations
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integrations and custom AI agents. Systems that deliver smart responses to customers and run chatbots that capture, filter, and qualify leads 24/7.
